card-status.faces.connection-lost.note: Word in the small badge at the top-left corner of the card while the connection to Home Assistant is down. One line; cut with an ellipsis at large text.

card-status.faces.connection-lost-at-tim.note: Sentence in the live region and under the corner badge once tapped, while the connection to Home Assistant is down. {time} is when it dropped: a time on the same day, a short date and time otherwise.

vars.time: The moment the connection dropped, formatted for the viewer's language and time format.

card-status.faces.not-updated.note: Word in the small badge at the top-left corner of the card when an entity with a quiet time has reported nothing for longer than that time. One line; cut with an ellipsis at large text.

card-status.faces.not-updated-since-time.note: Sentence in the live region and under the corner badge once tapped, when an entity with a quiet time has reported nothing for longer than that time. {time} is its last report.

vars.time: The moment of the entity's last report, formatted for the viewer's language and time format.

card-status.faces.reconnected.note: Word in the corner badge and the live region for a moment after the connection to Home Assistant returned, when the card had shown that it was lost.
